desc:
Welcome to Taurus Boxing V3.5! 🥊⭐

Experience one of ROBLOX’s most advanced boxing games, built around timing and stamina. Realistic animations make every punch feel impactful, while casual matches let you focus on skill and strategy. Earn in-game money to unlock gloves and other cosmetics, and explore a world that blends intense fights with a lived in, dynamic atmosphere.

Taurus Boxing offers:

- Customizable Keybinds
- Complete Mobile/Console Support 📱🎮
- Advanced Systems ⚙️
- Realistic Visuals 💥
- FPS Friendly Options ✅
- Purchasable Cosmetics (Gloves & Emotes) 🥊🕺

And many more!
